Editor removal record (epic middle-dowdy-sanddollar / story anguished-grown-junebug, ADR 0071 never implemented). Removed in commit 21dabcbb2c1fab1da7f81ccfd5a1aaedc2f2bdaf (Gerrit change 3038, merged 2026-10-19); parent 21dabcbb2c1fab1da7f81ccfd5a1aaedc2f2bdaf^.
Deleted: src/rebar/llm/workflow/{editor.py,editor_server.py,editor_contracts.py,bpmn.py,criterion_preview.py,prompt_authoring.py,rebar.moddle.json}; src/rebar/llm/workflow/editor_assets/; tests/e2e/; tests/unit/workflow/test_{bpmn,editor,editor_batch,editor_effective_policy,editor_roundtrip,editor_validate,prompt_authoring}.py; tests/unit/test_criterion_preview.py; tests/unit/test_browser_tier_optout.py; scripts/t5c_calibrate.py; docs/workflow-editor.md (in 3fc67e5cd067c73b00e3f26d593b60dde632d0c0, Gerrit change 3044, parent 3fc67e5cd067c73b00e3f26d593b60dde632d0c0^).
Restore: git checkout 21dabcbb2c1fab1da7f81ccfd5a1aaedc2f2bdaf^ -- <paths above> (for docs/workflow-editor.md use git checkout 3fc67e5cd067c73b00e3f26d593b60dde632d0c0^ -- docs/workflow-editor.md); then re-apply from `git show 21dabcbb2c1fab1da7f81ccfd5a1aaedc2f2bdaf`: the `edit` subparser (_cli/_parsers/advanced/workflow.py), `_workflow_edit` (_cli/_workflow_commands.py), the bpmn exports in llm/workflow/__init__.py, `resolve_preview_timeout` and its re-exports, Makefile `e2e-deps`, the CI Node/npm steps in .github/workflows/_build-and-test.yml, and the `PromptWriteError` taxonomy-test entry. The pyproject `artifacts` force-include and `e2e` marker were never removed (task dihedral-crying-grunion). Then rebuild the bundle: `npm --prefix src/rebar/llm/workflow/editor_assets ci && npm --prefix src/rebar/llm/workflow/editor_assets run build`.
